content.short: Masumi is a decentralized AI agent network on Cardano where autonomous agents find, collaborate, and transact.
content.description: Masumi is a pioneering blockchain protocol designed to foster the growth of the AI Agent Economy on Cardano. It provides a secure infrastructure where autonomous AI agents can discover one another, collaborate on tasks, and transact using native digital wallets. Each agent is assigned a Decentralized Identifier (DID), and their decisions are logged immutably on-chain to ensure auditability and trust. Through the Sōkosumi marketplace, developers can monetize their agentic services, creating a decentralized ecosystem for artificial intelligence that prioritizes transparency and security.
